newsitem.title: UK: UK Flotta Sept loadings down 1.1 mln bls at 4.6 mln.
newsitem.headline: UK Flotta Sept loadings down 1.1 mln bls at 4.6 mln.

text.p: Britain's North Sea Flotta crude pipeline system has scheduled eight cargoes to load 4.6 million barrels in September, traders said on Friday.
The September programme compares with a revised August programme of 5.7 million barrels in 10 cargoes.
Six cargoes of 600,000 barrels and two cargoes of 500,000 barrels will load in September, giving an estimated average daily flow of 153,000 barrels per day (bpd), the traders said.
August average flow was estimated at 183,000 bpd after programme revisions.
One of 11 Flotta cargoes due to load in August was cancelled and the remaining cargoes were deferred by three or four days late last month because of lower than expected production.
The original August programme scheduled 6.3 million barrels.
